table inet fw4 { # handle 4
	set zarap_clients_v4 { # handle 3
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 192.168.10.167 }
	}

	set zarap_clients_mac { # handle 4
		type ether_addr
		elements = { ea:76:7f:24:d1:79 }
	}

	set zarap_direct_v4 { # handle 5
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16 }
	}

	set zarap_direct_v6 { # handle 6
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { fc00::/7 }
	}

	chain zarap_prerouting { # handle 1
		type filter hook prerouting priority mangle; policy accept;
		ip saddr @zarap_clients_v4 ip daddr @zarap_direct_v4 return # handle 7
		ip saddr @zarap_clients_v4 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } meta mark set 0x00005a52 tproxy ip to 127.0.0.1:7893 accept # handle 9
	}

	chain zarap_protect_tproxy { # handle 2
		type filter hook input priority filter - 10; policy accept;
		meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 7893 meta mark != 0x00005a52 drop # handle 11
	}
}
table inet other { # handle 5
	chain someones_rule { # handle 1
		type filter hook prerouting priority mangle; policy accept;
		ip saddr 10.1.2.3 meta mark set 0x00005a52 accept # handle 2
	}
}
